name: Bike Boost
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Attach the booster engine to the tricycle. Throw away the flower bouquet from the basket.
Put the propeller hat on the groom.
Give the sun’s sunglasses to the groom.
Tap the groom’s legs to pedal harder.
Drag the bride off the tricycle to make it fastest.
